```{r}
my_data <- read.csv("PVJ Data - Sheet1.csv")

# View(my_data)

names(my_data) <- as.character(unlist(my_data[1, ]))

my_data <- my_data[-1, ]

my_data <- my_data[
  !is.na(my_data$Course) & my_data$Course != "", 
]




```

```{r}

library(tidyverse)
ggplot(my_data, aes(x = Subject, fill = Grade)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  labs(
    title = "Grade Distribution by Subject",
    x = "Subject",
    y = "Percentage of Courses",
    fill = "Grade"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )
```

```{r}
my_data %>%
  count(Subject, Grade) %>%
  group_by(Subject) %>%
  mutate(Percentage = n / sum(n)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Grade, y = Subject, fill = Percentage)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "steelblue",
                      labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(
    title = "Grade Distribution by Subject",
    x = "Grade",
    y = "Subject",
    fill = "Percentage"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
ggplot(my_data, aes(x = Grade, fill = Grade)) +
  geom_bar() +
  facet_wrap(~ Subject) +
  labs(
    title = "Grade Distribution by Subject",
    x = "Grade",
    y = "Number of Courses"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```
